scope_note: A new section in the coverage-completion round the repository owner authorised on 2026-09-14 (audits/coverage/2026-09-14/STUDY-GUIDE-COVERAGE-COMPLETION-PLAN.json); no earlier audit binds it. The planned scope was six 247 CMR 9.01 prohibitions and the recovery program; it now covers every 9.01 paragraph no other section teaches ((1), (2), (5), (9)-(14) and (18)-(21)) and the 247 CMR 9.03 advertising bar. Paragraphs (3), (4), (15) and (16) are planned for SG-MA-PRACTICE-STANDARDS, (6) and (7) for SG-MA-RETURNS-RECALLS-AND-PRODUCT-INTEGRITY, (8) is taught through 247 CMR 9.21 in SG-CS-SECURITY-AND-DISPOSAL, and (17) in SG-MA-PHARMACY-INTERNS. Six planned records add glosses or overstatements to the official text and were replaced before freezing: MA-CONDUCT-ANTI-CIRCUMVENTION, MA-CONDUCT-DECEPTIVE-ACT (states that no reliance or loss is needed, on which 9.01(9) is silent), MA-BLANK-PRESCRIPTION-FORMS, MA-SUBSTANDARD-RECIPIENT-LIMIT and MA-CONDUCT-INSTITUTIONAL-DISPENSING ("same house" for "same household") by rules stating each paragraph as written, and MA-URAMP by MA-URAMP-STATUTE-ADMISSION-AND-EFFECT, MA-URAMP-STATUTE-RECORDS-AND-REPORTING, MA-PHARMACY-REHABILITATION-PROGRAM-STATUTE (M.G.L. c. 112, ss. 24H and 65G) and MA-URAMP-PROGRAM-TERMS (the program's own pages and manual, taught as dated program terms). The official program sources disagree in places (the number of boards, the application route, and whether a pending complaint is or may be dismissed); the section teaches the statute as the law and the manual as the program's description of its practice. MA-CONDUCT-REFERRAL-REMUNERATION stays cited; MA-DISPENSING-DEFINITION is cited for 247 CMR 2.00. Scope gate: every signal declined. MA-USP-CURRENCY-DISPLACEMENT, MA-PHARMACIST-COMPETENCE-SCOPE, MA-COMPOUNDING-REFUSAL-LIMIT, MA-LICENSEE-CONFIDENTIALITY, MA-RETURN-ACCEPTANCE-DUTY and MA-PRACTICE-HOUR-CEILING are 9.01 paragraphs placed in other sections as above; MA-CE-DEFINITIONS, MA-PRECEPTOR-DEFINITIONS and MA-TECHNICIAN-DEFINITIONS are other 247 CMR 2.00 definitions outside the scope; MA-URAMP is the record replaced above. Practice links: MA-Q-0212, MA-Q-0290, MA-Q-0295, MA-Q-0296, MA-Q-0315 and MA-Q-0326; MA-Q-0291 and MA-Q-0420 left the links because their wording departs from 9.01(13).
